name: PullPriorityCustomers
description: Morning pull, step 1 (plan 04.11, part A): pulls Priority's customer cards into Customers. Upsert by customerCode and writes ONLY the Priority columns listed in code (see Customers technicalDescription); our columns are never overwritten. A customer that is no longer returned is never deleted: priorityStatus becomes לא פעיל בפריוריטי (and back when it returns). Priority is not connected yet: the source is a stub, so the action returns ok:false, reason "Priority sync not connected yet" and writes nothing; rewritten in the sync turn. An empty source (0 customers) is treated as a failed pull: nothing is marked inactive. dryRun (default true) only reports. Never writes to Priority or contacts anyone.

dryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be written

importBatchId.description: ImportBatches row of the morning run this pull belongs to (optional)
